sloka: इत्येवमुक्तो मात्रेदं रामो भ्रातरमब्रवीत् ।प्राञ्जलिं प्रह्वमासीनमभिवीख्स्य स्मयन्निव ॥२-४-४२॥
transliteration: ityevamukto mātredaṁ rāmo bhrātaramabravīt ।prāñjaliṁ prahvamāsīnamabhivīkhsya smayanniva ॥2-4-42॥

translations.english: "Enjoy, Saumitri, the enjoyments you desire and the fruits of the kingdom. It is for your sake that I desire my life and the kingdom too."
